verdict.rationale: Cursor documents an official CLI that lets you "interact with AI agents directly from your terminal to write, review, and modify code", installed via `curl https://cursor.com/install | bash`. It supports interactive use and a headless print mode (`agent -p --force`) with a permission config for local shell and file access. Worktree and subagent support explicitly extend to the CLI, and a probe confirms the CLI page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the local CLI agent experience.
